threat_event: Ransomware from the corporate network spreads to SCADA and MES and halts all processing lines and cold-chain monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad corporate-to-OT firewall rules; MES dual-homed on both networks; no EDR on OT hosts; shared OT logins
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (broad corporate-to-OT rules; MES on both networks); EV-009 (no EDR on OT hosts); EV-005 (shared OT logins); EV-029 (incident log)
existing_controls: EDR on office endpoints; MFA on IT VPN and email; nightly SCADA and MES backups
treatment_plan: Segment OT behind an OT DMZ and remove the MES dual-homing; EDR or application allowlisting on OT hosts; offline OT backups; OT incident runbook (P08)

threat_event: Attacker uses the controls integrator's shared VPN account to reach SCADA and change process setpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared always-on integrator VPN account without MFA; no session logging
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (shared always-on integrator VPN account without MFA); EV-025 (2025 VPN setup); EV-047 (remote session interviews)
existing_controls: Firewall allows the VPN only to the SCADA server
treatment_plan: Named integrator accounts with MFA; access enabled per request and time-limited; session recording; quarterly review

threat_event: Insider or remote attacker changes the cure (sodium nitrite) or brine formulation in the recipe system so that product reaches consumers over-cured
threat_source: Disgruntled employee or outside attacker with stolen credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared recipe-system logins; no two-person approval or change log for formulations; not in the vulnerability assessment
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (shared recipe logins; no approval step); EV-018 (dosing skid not in the vulnerability assessment); EV-047 (formulation change interviews)
existing_controls: Cure room locked; formulation targets checked at batching by line supervisor
treatment_plan: Named logins; two-person approval and hash-verified recipe releases; setpoint change alerts to FSQA; add the dosing skid to the vulnerability assessment

threat_event: Compromised HMI or PLC opens CIP chemical valves into the seafood brine tank during production (intentional adulteration)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No hardwired CIP interlock on the seafood brine tank; shared HMI logins; brine tank not an actionable process step in the 2023 plan
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 seafood brine tank; CIP manifold
likelihood_basis: EV-014 (no interlock on the seafood brine tank drawing); EV-005 (shared HMI logins); EV-018 (brine tank not an actionable process step)
existing_controls: Brine tank hatch locked; sanitation performs CIP only on the third shift
treatment_plan: Install a hardwired CIP interlock like Line 2; designate the brine tank an actionable process step with monitoring and verification

threat_event: Loss of cold-chain monitoring goes unnoticed and product is held above critical limits
threat_source: Monitoring outage (gateway, Wi-Fi, carrier, or SMS failure)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SMS alert path to one person; no escalation; no manual log procedure
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (single SMS alert recipient); EV-024 (no manual temperature log procedure); EV-046 (BIA interviews)
existing_controls: Cold-chain SaaS alerting; supervisors walk coolers each shift
treatment_plan: Escalating alerts to three roles with acknowledgment; hourly manual temperature log during outages; gateway on its own network

threat_event: Attacker reaches the ammonia refrigeration controller through the contractor's cellular modem and stops compressors or upsets the system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on cellular modem; controller not inventoried or monitored
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (contractor's cellular modem); EV-048 (modem on the controller)
existing_controls: Ammonia detection and alarms are hardwired and independent of the controller
treatment_plan: Remove the always-on modem; route contractor access through the OT remote access gateway with MFA and approval

threat_event: OT backups are encrypted or lost along with production, so SCADA, MES, and PLC programs cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups on a domain-joined device in the same room; never restore-tested; PLC programs only on one laptop
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (OT backups on a domain-joined device; no restores; PLC programs on one laptop); EV-016 (no cloud restores)
existing_controls: Nightly backups of SCADA and MES servers
treatment_plan: Offline and cloud immutable copies of OT backups; PLC program repository; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Electronic CCP records are altered, lost, or cannot be attributed, and FSIS finds the HACCP system inadequate
threat_source: Workforce member (error or misconduct); system failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Historian audit trail disabled; shared records-app admin; typed initials instead of signatures
likelihood_basis: EV-007 (historian audit trail off); EV-006 (shared administrator; typed initials)
existing_controls: Daily cloud backups; pre-shipment record review
treatment_plan: Enable historian audit trail; named accounts and e-signatures in the records app; document integrity controls

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a supplier or freight payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No callback verification for bank changes; no phishing exercises
likelihood_basis: EV-026 (no phishing exercises); EV-046 (Controller interview on payment changes)
existing_controls: MFA on email; email filtering
treatment_plan: Callback verification for vendor bank changes; quarterly phishing exercises

threat_event: The food defense plan and vulnerability assessment are copied from the open file share and used to plan an attack
threat_source: Insider or intruder with office access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan stored on a share open to all office staff; no classification
likelihood_basis: EV-042 (plan on a share open to all office staff); EV-024 (no data classification)
existing_controls: File share requires sign-in with MFA
treatment_plan: Classify the plan as Restricted; move to a restricted library with access logging

threat_event: Departing employee takes formulations and customer pricing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No classification or download monitoring; shared recipe logins
likelihood_basis: EV-042 (formulations on an open share); EV-005 (shared recipe logins)
regulatory_driver: None (trade secret protection; NIST CSF 2.0 benchmark)
existing_controls: Confidentiality agreements for sales and R&D
treatment_plan: Restricted library for formulations; download alerts; exit checklist

threat_event: FDA inspection finds the food defense plan not reanalyzed and its management components incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reanalysis after 2025 changes; missing monitoring and verification records
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (no reanalysis since 2023); EV-019 (missed monitoring weeks; no reviewer sign-off)
existing_controls: 2023 plan signed; this gap analysis (P03)
treatment_plan: Reanalysis with cyber-physical steps; complete monitoring and verification records; FSQA Manager tracks due dates

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported operating system on two HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS; no EDR; reachable from corporate network
likelihood_basis: EV-013 (2 HMIs on an unsupported OS); EV-009 (no EDR on OT hosts); EV-011 (reachable from the corporate network)
existing_controls: Behind the corporate-to-OT firewall
treatment_plan: Replace the two HMIs; isolate them in the meantime

threat_event: Malware enters OT on removable media or the engineering laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No media controls; engineering laptop also used for email
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (USB ports open on HMIs); EV-009 (antivirus only on the engineering laptop); EV-047 (engineering laptop used for email)
existing_controls: Antivirus on the engineering laptop
treatment_plan: Dedicated OT engineering workstation; media scanning kiosk; block USB storage on HMIs

threat_event: Cold-chain monitoring vendor outage or breach removes remote alerting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor security review; no manual fallback
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (no security terms in the vendor contract); EV-024 (no manual log procedure)
existing_controls: Vendor status page
treatment_plan: Review vendor SOC 2 (P09); manual log procedure (R-005)

threat_event: ERP or WMS outage stops order release and shipping
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; no downtime procedure
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no contingency or downtime procedure); EV-046 (BIA interviews)
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments
treatment_plan: Paper pick-and-ship procedure; daily inventory export

threat_event: Hurricane causes extended utility power and network loss
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generator fuel for about 72 hours; single ISP
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (generator with about 72 hours of fuel); EV-011 (single ISP)
existing_controls: Standby generator for refrigeration, SCADA, and server room; hurricane checklist
treatment_plan: Fuel contract with priority delivery; cellular backup for cold-chain gateway and SCADA alarms

threat_event: Internet outage cuts cold-chain SaaS alerting and access to cloud records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ISP; gateway depends on internet for alerting
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (single ISP); EV-035 (gateway buffers 24 hours)
existing_controls: Local gateway buffers readings for 24 hours
treatment_plan: Second ISP or cellular failover

threat_event: Former employee or temporary worker uses a still-known shared HMI or recipe login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared logins cannot be revoked per person; passwords unchanged for years
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (shared logins); EV-004 (production terminations not sent to the Controls Engineer)
existing_controls: Physical badge access removed at termination
treatment_plan: Named logins (R-003); interim password rotation at every production-staff termination

threat_event: Credential stuffing on the online store exposes customer contact data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer accounts without MFA; vendor-hosted
likelihood_basis: EV-043 (no MFA on customer accounts; vendor bot protection)
existing_controls: Vendor bot protection and rate limiting; hosted payment page (no card data)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the General Manager: residual risk Low; vendor-managed

threat_event: Payroll vendor breach exposes employee Social Security numbers and bank accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor security not reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (payroll contract; no security review); EV-031 (payroll vendor)
existing_controls: Vendor contract with breach notice clause
treatment_plan: Obtain and review the payroll vendor's SOC 2 report

threat_event: Staff over-rely on the AI vision system and foreign material or a wrong lot code ships
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No validation protocol; role relative to the metal detector CCP undefined
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (pilot since May 2026); EV-024 (no validation protocol)
existing_controls: Metal detector CCP unchanged; QA reviews rejects
treatment_plan: Validation protocol; written statement that AI-001 is not a CCP monitoring device; monthly performance review (P10)

threat_event: AI vision vendor's remote access to the edge server is used to pivot into OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor remote tool always on; edge server on the control network
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (vendor remote support of the edge server); EV-048 (edge server on the control network)
existing_controls: Vendor contract confidentiality clause
treatment_plan: Move the edge server to the OT DMZ; vendor access through the OT gateway with MFA

threat_event: Staff paste formulations or plan content into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No AI use policy or approved-tools list
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (staff use public chatbots; no approved-tools list)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list and POL-05 statement; web filtering for unapproved AI tools

threat_event: A controls vendor or engineer loads an untested PLC or smokehouse program change, causing a cook or chill deviation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT change control; no pre-release testing
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (changes without review records); EV-047 (PLC change interviews)
existing_controls: Line supervisors watch the first batch after changes
treatment_plan: OT change procedure with FSQA sign-off for any change touching a CCP

threat_event: Production staff do not report suspicious activity near actionable process steps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security or food defense awareness training for production, sanitation, and temporary staff
likelihood_basis: EV-026 (no floor training); EV-020 (temporary worker awareness entries end before 2025)
existing_controls: Supervisors present on every shift
treatment_plan: Food defense and security awareness at hire and annually for all production staff, including temporary workers

threat_event: Cloud administrator account takeover leads to deletion of records and backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups in the same account as production
likelihood_basis: EV-015 (backups in the production account); EV-001 (hardware keys for the 2 cloud administrators)
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for the two cloud administrators
treatment_plan: Accepted by the General Manager: residual risk Low with MFA; backup separation tracked under R-007

threat_event: Logs expire before an incident is noticed, so recipe changes and intrusions cannot be investigated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30 to 90 day retention; no review
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (firewall logs 30 days); EV-015 (cloud logs 90 days); EV-047 (no log review)
existing_controls: Default logging on
treatment_plan: Central log workspace with 1-year retention; weekly review

threat_event: Cold-chain sensor gateway on corporate Wi-Fi is tampered with or used as a pivot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway on shared Wi-Fi with default settings
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (gateway on the corporate Wi-Fi)
existing_controls: Wi-Fi uses WPA2-Enterprise
treatment_plan: Move the gateway to a dedicated IoT network segment

threat_event: Outsider enters the seafood room and adds a contaminant at the dip mixing step
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Visitor escort relies on staff vigilance
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (no CCTV over dip mixing; visitor escort); EV-048 (walkthrough)
existing_controls: Badge access; CCTV at docks; visitor escort; locked ingredient room
treatment_plan: Add CCTV coverage of the dip mixing area; verify badge logs weekly

threat_event: MES outage forces manual labeling and a lot-code or allergen label error leads to a recall
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No tested manual labeling procedure
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no downtime labeling procedure); EV-046 (BIA interviews on manual labels)
existing_controls: Label verification at line start
treatment_plan: Manual labeling procedure with second-person check; include in downtime drills

threat_event: Attacker on the corporate network logs into the refrigeration controller web interface with the default administrator password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer default password (found in P07 testing); controller reachable from corporate network
likelihood_basis: EV-IA-5 (default password found in P07 testing); EV-011 (controller reachable from the corporate network)
existing_controls: Hardwired ammonia detection
treatment_plan: Change the password now; restrict the interface to the OT engineering subnet
